statement: Let 0 ≤ d < 1, let H be finite and ancestral, and suppose x = PHx, ∥x∥ ≥ 1−d, and ∥x ± y∥ ≤ 1. Fix a head norming test p with ρ(p) = 1 and x(p) = ∥x∥, and a finite ancestral set K ⊃ H. For each τ ∈ {−1, 1} choose any finite represented atom law with mean PK(x + τy), 28 and denote its expectation by Eτ . For an atom A = ∑︁ i aidSi , put bi = p(Si), A◦ = ∑︁ i bidSi , and L = 1 − ∑︁ i b2 i . Then Eτ [︄ L + ∑︂ i (ai − bi)2 ]︄ ≤ 4d, Eτ ∥A − A◦ ∥ ≤ 2 √ d. (12.3) If b(g) is the replaced crossing sum at gate g, put mτ (g) = Eτ |b(g)| and m = (m1 + m−1)/2. These nonnegative vectors satisfy mτ ≤ 2m coordinatewise, ∥m∥2 ≤ √ 6d. (12.4)
